# Versapay

Versapay (VPY) is a Financial Services company. Versapay is a company that offers unified accounts receivable automation platforms to simplify the invoice-to-cash process by automating invoicing, facilitating B2B payments, and streamlining cash application with AI. Versapay employs 295 people (+5.4% YoY, +19 people) and has an annual revenue of $80M, founded in 2006. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, United States, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including United States, Canada, Israel, Brazil, and Nigeria). IPO 2008.

## About

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity, ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms. By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $170B+ in payments volume annually.

cards.claim: Mentioned on: Turning the Dials Up On Key  Handoff Points -   Russell Lester, CFO, Versapay
cards.snippet: we're we're wondering how you might be bringing greater Clarity to your to your metrics as you look to educate the the team in organization yeah great question so I like to take a funnel oriented view to the client journey and think about what are the key milestones in the client Journey the traditional flow would be you move from being a lead to an opportunity to being one and then in our business model you would go from from us winning an opportunity to going through a Professional Services implementation process from implementations to presumably going live and from going live to doing what I call ramping and ramping would be that that time where you're revving up your use of the product you're increasing your active use of the product you're accelerating the opportunity of achieving value in our in our collaborative AR Network and so those different key milestones and then hopefully you stay around and become a happy active and sticky client that tells other people about Versa pay so it's really the instrumentation of those handoff points that I've I've turned the dials on to make sure we truly understand the underlying factors contributing to each of those because if there's a breakdown in one then what gets passed on in the next stage is smaller if we can increase each handoff point along the way then what comes through the revenue engine on the back end will be greater [Music]
